instructions: Mark a drug a prodrug ONLY when a candidate says the drug ITSELF is inactive (or is a prodrug) and its effect comes from a named active metabolite. A drug that is active itself AND has an active metabolite is NOT a prodrug; a sentence about a different prodrug (an ester of this drug, another molecule) does not count. Answer {drug_id: {index, metabolite, drug_id|null}} with the metabolite named in that very sentence; omit a drug that is not a prodrug.
